changelog:
Initial release of github-memory skill:

- Enables agents to store, recall, and search GitHub issue and PR context using BlueColumn persistent memory.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key for access.
- Provides easy-to-use API endpoints for storing notes, creating quick notes, and recalling information.
- Supports workflows for context recall and personalized agent responses.
- Includes clear setup and usage instructions.
summary: Give AI agents Remember GitHub issues and PRs. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent tracks repos, issues, and pull requests; when the user wants to store, recall, or search github memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
